messages.subject: Announcement: New CRAN release - v2.2.0
parts:
camtrapR version 2.2.0 is now available on CRAN. It is the first update on CRAN in almost 2 years and contains all changes that accumulated on GitHub since then, e.g.:
  • community (multi-species) occupancy models (with a new vignette)
  • optical character recognition for reading data field in images
  • improved camera operation matrices
  • many bugfixes and other small improvements
For a full list of changes, see:
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/news/news.html

Installation as usual via:
install.packages("camtrapR")

If there are any issues with the new release, please let me know.
